notes: v10.4 BUILD REFRESH (2026-11-20, b4770 — the twentieth cut — a price keeps its decimals; spelled letters stand together; your own corrections learn without asking, notarized): (1) A price with decimals is written whole. "8.79 USD" came out as "8.USD 79" because the amount rule did not know decimals and took the "79" for a number of its own. A currency code now goes in front of the whole amount ("USD 8.79", "HKD 1,200.50"), and an amount with cents takes its symbol ("8.79 dollars" is "$8.79"). (2) Letters you spell stand together. The speech engine writes spelled letters with dashes ("N-A- T-E-H-E-R-K"). The dashes are removed and the letters are written together in capitals, whatever they spell. A leading "A" is no longer lost from a spelled run. (3) Your own corrections learn without an approval.
